ios.desc:
FastMath – Scan, Solve, Study & Ask

FastMath turns your camera into a powerful AI math solver, study companion and homework helper.

FastMath 3.x represents a new generation of FastMath, completely rebuilt and far beyond the experience of earlier 2.x and 1.x versions. The app now combines high-accuracy math solving, improved question detection, full-page worksheet scanning, multi-question solving, step-by-step explanations, and AI follow-up questions in one fast and organized workflow.

Take a photo of a single math problem or scan an entire worksheet. FastMath detects the questions, solves them together, and presents the answers clearly so you can review the whole page without scanning problems one by one.

FastMath is built for high-accuracy math solving, with improved detection, stronger reasoning, more reliable answers, and clearer step-by-step explanations across a wide range of math problems.

Need more than just the answer? Open any question to explore a detailed solution, understand how the result was reached, and ask AI follow-up questions whenever something is unclear.

SCAN AN ENTIRE WORKSHEET

Capture a full worksheet, homework page, or practice sheet in one shot. FastMath can detect multiple math questions from the same image and process them together.

SOLVE MULTIPLE QUESTIONS AT ONCE

Stop scanning one problem at a time. FastMath identifies the questions on the page and gives you organized answers in one streamlined workflow.

HIGH-ACCURACY AI MATH SOLVING

FastMath is designed to provide accurate and reliable solutions with improved question recognition and advanced AI reasoning.

STEP-BY-STEP SOLUTIONS

Select any problem to view detailed solution steps. Follow the reasoning and understand how the answer was reached instead of seeing only the final result.

ASK AI ABOUT ANY STEP

Have a question about a specific part of the solution? Ask a follow-up question and get an additional explanation directly inside FastMath.

BUILT FOR STUDY

FastMath is more than an answer scanner. Use it to check homework, review practice problems, understand difficult concepts, prepare for exams, and study more efficiently.

ORGANIZED QUESTION CARDS

Each detected problem is organized into its own clear card, making it easy to move between questions, answers, and detailed solutions.

EXPORT SOLUTIONS TO PDF

Select the solutions you need and export them as a clean PDF for studying, saving, reviewing, or sharing.

 FEATURES

• Full-page worksheet scanning
• Mul

I don't think we need Generative AI for 7th grade. College, perhaps, but how much advanced math is there in 7th grade these days?
quotes.story_title: Sal Khan is pioneering innovation in education again
